modules.name: 연동
modules.note: 대부분의 provider 라우터는 app-connection-endpoints.ts의 공용 helper로 provider별 CRUD 6종(GET /, GET /available, GET /:connectionId, GET /connection-name/:connectionName, POST /, PATCH /:connectionId)을 생성하므로, 실제 노출 endpoint 수는 정규식 집계보다 수십 배 많다. provider 수는 app-connection-routers 파일 수로 센다.

modules.name: CLI·SDK
modules.note: CLI(github.com/Infisical/cli)와 SDK는 별도 저장소. 분모 밖이며 연동 대상으로만 기록.

ee_coupling.definition: backend/src files outside ee/ that contain an import of @app/ee/... or a relative path into an ee directory

counting_notes: Routes are `<receiver>.route({...})` objects found by a bracket-balanced scan, so double-quoted, single-quoted and template-literal urls are all counted; url_kind tells them apart.

route_count is a count of route definitions in source. Helper functions such as app-connection-endpoints register the same shape once per provider router, so exposed endpoints exceed the definition count (see route_definitions_outside_router_files).
A route whose method or url is not a literal is counted with url_kind 'dynamic'.
